# Bundled esptool

ESP Loader redistributes the official standalone `esptool` 5.4.0 executables
without modification. `esptool` remains a separate subprocess and is not
linked into ESP Loader.

Upstream project: https://github.com/espressif/esptool

Release: https://github.com/espressif/esptool/releases/tag/v5.4.0

Corresponding source: https://github.com/espressif/esptool/tree/v5.4.0

License: GNU General Public License version 2 or later. See `LICENSE` in this
directory. Release packages must retain this notice and the license file.
